newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.

text.p: Total money market mutual fund assets in the week ended April 2 rose to $975.36 billion from a revised $965.94 billion the prior week, an industry trade group said Thursday.
The Investment Company Institute said assets of the nation's 665 retail money market mutual funds rose $5.79 billion to $654.03 billion in the week.
Of the retail funds, assets of the 402 taxable money market funds rose $5.02 billion to $534.04 billion, while assets of the 263 tax-exempt funds rose $768.4 million to $120 billion, the group said.

The ICI said assets of the 323 institutional money market funds rose $3.63 billion to $321.33 billion. Of these, assets of the 260 taxable money market funds increased $2.72 billion to $287.85 billion, while assets of the 63 tax-exempt funds grew $911.2 million to $33.48 billion, it said.
The ICI revised last week's money market mutual fund assets to $965.94 billion from $965.25 billion.
